releases.name: v0.3.0 — Shared cache and sprint board links
releases.body:
## What's new
- Share cached sprint and ticket data across OpenCode windows, including windows in different workspaces.
- Synchronize sidebar updates and Jira rate-limit cooldowns through OpenCode's durable storage.
- Keep cache entries isolated by hashed site, board, cloud-ID override, and credential identity; raw credentials are not stored.
- Add small randomized delays to background refreshes to reduce simultaneous Jira requests. Manual refresh still bypasses freshness while respecting cooldowns.
- Click sprint names to open the configured board's active-sprints view. Names underline on hover; the arrow alone collapses or expands the section.

## Privacy and behavior
Ticket metadata now persists on disk across restarts through OpenCode storage. There are no plugin-managed cache files or locks. Simultaneous stale checks can still cause duplicate requests. See the README's shared-cache and privacy section for retention and storage details.

## Verification
40 unit tests pass, along with typecheck, build, and package validation. OpenCode smoke tests cover cross-window updates, credential isolation, cooldowns, restart persistence, board links, and arrow-only collapse/expand.

releases.name: v0.2.0 — Active sprint names
releases.body:
## What's new
- Show the active sprint name in the sidebar heading.
- List sprint names when multiple sprints are active.
- Wrap long sprint names without hiding the refresh control.
- Keep empty workflow groups visible, including To do and In progress.

## Verification
- 24 unit tests pass, along with typecheck and build.
- Installed-package OpenCode smoke tests cover single, parallel, and long sprint names, empty groups, and collapse/expand behavior.

The npm publishing workflow runs automatically for this release.
